issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify the Animal.name attribute as a String (private String name), but the solution implementation declares the field as a StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name). This type mismatch between the specification and the reference solution is unexpected and may confuse students about the required type for the name attribute and the expected getter/setter implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal.name field type consistent with the problem statement. Either change the solution implementation to use a String for the name (private String name) and adjust the constructor/getter/setter accordingly, or update the problem statement/UML to state that a StringBuilder is intentionally used for the name. Preferably use String in the solution to match the specification and reduce student confusion.
